name: Whissant
look: a round green chick with a smug half-lidded eye, a leafy wing over its beak as it whistles, yellow spots on its crown and belly and two small points on its head
entry: It whistles through its leafy wing all day long. It never plays the same tune twice, and it gets very smug when other Pokémon stop to listen.
how: One of the second A. Fakemon trio's starters: pick it at the starter screen (its A. Fakemon II page).
Wild: very rare in forests and plains.
